title: Chip
description: A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags, without a border. Off: the subtle button fill; on: the raised surface (or its tone's tint) with a leading check, so the state does not rest on colour alone. 34px, 44px on a touch phone.
when: Several filters that can be on at once (materials, device types).
Removable active filters above a list.
a11y: A button with aria-pressed when it toggles; keep the text short.
Selected shows a leading check (not colour alone); on a touch phone each chip is at least 44 × 44px, real size, so chips in a row never share a tap point.

examples.title: Toggle filters
examples.description: tone tints the chip while it is on; every chip on shows a check.
